run_quarel_preprocessing: run the QUAREL dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple seeds
create_quarel_dataset_instance: create a QUAREL dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace quarel dataset for text-to-text tasks
extract_answer_string: extract the answer string from a QUAREL datapoint by parsing options A and B from the question
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace QUAREL dataset split to a list of question and answer string tuples
load_quarel_dataset: load the HuggingFace quarel dataset using datasets.load_dataset for few-shot learning
